title.description: Title to use for the form. Example: "My new form"

fields.description: Array of field objects to use in the form. Each field must include type, title, and ref.

workspace.description: Workspace to place the form in. Pass the full https://api.typeform.com/workspaces/{id} URL in href.

theme.description: Theme to use for the form. Pass the full https://api.typeform.com/themes/{id} URL in href.

thankyou_screens.description: Array of thank you screen objects.

actions.description: Register an image from a URL or base64 payload.
actions.name: create-image

url.description: URL of the image to import. Example: "https://example.com/image.png"

image.description: Base64-encoded image data without data URI prefix. Example: "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUg..."

file_name.description: File name for the image. Example: "newimage.gif"

name.description: Name for the theme. Example: "My new theme"

question.description: Color the theme will apply to questions. Example: "#FFFFFF"

answer.description: Color the theme will apply to answers. Example: "#4FB0AE"

button.description: Color the theme will apply to buttons. Example: "#4FB0AE"

background.description: Color the theme will apply to the background. Example: "#000000"

question.description: Color the theme will apply to questions. Example: "#FFFFFF"

answer.description: Color the theme will apply to answers. Example: "#4FB0AE"

button.description: Color the theme will apply to buttons. Example: "#4FB0AE"

background.description: Color the theme will apply to the background. Example: "#000000"

form_id.description: Unique ID for the form. Example: "WMpBq4vc"

tag.description: Unique name you want to use for the webhook. Example: "my-webhook"

enabled.description: True if you want to send responses to the webhook immediately. Otherwise, false.

event_types.description: Object specifying the event types to which this webhook is subscribed. Example: {"form_response": true}

secret.description: If specified, will be used to sign the webhook payload with HMAC SHA256, so that you can verify that it came from Typeform.

image_id.description: The image ID to delete. Example: "pshDCOusAapn"

actions.description: Bulk-delete one or more form responses.
actions.name: delete-responses

response_ids.description: Array of response IDs to delete. Up to 1000 IDs per call.

formId.description: Unique ID for the form. Example: "u6nXL7"

tag.description: Unique name for the webhook. Example: "my-webhook"

form_id.description: The unique ID of the form. Example: "WMpBq4vc"

image_id.description: Unique ID for the image to retrieve. Example: "pshDCOusAapn"

theme_id.description: Unique ID for the theme. Example: "I3NkUFrI"

actions.description: Retrieve a single webhook by tag for a Typeform form.
actions.name: get-webhook

form_id.description: Unique ID for the form. Example: "abc123"

tag.description: Unique name for the webhook. Example: "phoenix"

page_size.description: Number of responses per page. Default 25, max 1000.

since.description: Include responses submitted on or after this timestamp (ISO 8601 or unix).

until.description: Include responses submitted on or before this timestamp (ISO 8601 or unix).

after.description: Include responses submitted after this response token (exclusive). Cannot be combined with sort.

response_type.description: Types to include: started, partial, completed. Defaults to completed only.

sort.description: Sort order: {field_id},{asc|desc}. Cannot be combined with after/before/cursor.

fields.description: Comma-separated field IDs to include in answers.

answered_fields.description: Comma-separated field IDs that must have answers.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Maps to the before parameter. Cannot be combined with sort.
Pagination cursor (page number). Omit for the first page.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default 10, max 200.

form_id.description: Unique ID for the form. Example: "WMpBq4vc"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number). Omit for the first page.

page_size.description: Number of results to retrieve per page. Default is 10, maximum is 200.

search.description: Returns items that contain the specified string.

actions.description: Partially update a form using JSON Patch operations
actions.name: patch-form

operations.description: JSON Patch operations array per RFC 6902

theme_id.description: Unique ID for the theme. Example: "I3NkUFrI"

actions.description: Partially update a workspace using JSON Patch operations
actions.name: update-workspace

workspace_id.description: The workspace ID to update. Example: "wCjDgv"

email.description: Email of the member to add or remove. Example: "jane@example.com"

role.description: Member role. Required when adding a member. Example: "owner"

operations.description: JSON Patch operations Typeform supports for workspaces. Example: [{ op: "replace", path: "/name", value: "New name" }] or [{ op: "add", path: "/members", value: { email: "jane@example.com", role: "owner" } }]
